Two distinct causal histories.

Public release 2.1 / programming puzzle

Build a causal evaluator.
Debug tomorrow.

At midnight, a city receives a complete record of tomorrow's disasters. Build the engine that opens it, repair the smallest causes, and discover who decided that tomorrow was allowed to have only one history.

75scored cases
10,000nominal points
8problem families
4presentation languages

One city, eight ways to reason

  • ORIENT — learn the record and witness loop
  • CASCADE — change the smallest cause
  • MERGE — reconstruct conflicting histories
  • PULSE — program bounded event streams
  • MOSAIC — rebuild supported topology
  • LENS — synchronize without forgetting
  • COVENANT — prove local policies globally
  • PARADOX — audit uniqueness
